name: Manabalss.lv initiative "Par progresīvu nodokļu sistēmu"
detail: Asks for a progressive income-tax system and higher taxes on the richest and on luxury consumption; no tax on net wealth is named.

name: Mārtiņš Kossovičs / Progresīvie inheritance-tax proposal
detail: 2021 discussion concerns inheritance tax; a 2025 fact-check says there was no evidence of a submitted 49% bill. This does not establish their position on a wealth-stock tax.

name: Vita Liberte
detail: Discusses a UK study suggesting a one-off wealth levy might be effective, while stressing country-specific evaluation; this is not a clear personal recommendation for Latvia.

name: Dainis Zelmenis
detail: 2012 interview uses the phrase tax on wealth to describe progressive income tax, rather than a tax on the stock of assets.

name: Jānis Ošlejs
detail: 2012 interview says he is willing to pay higher taxes but does not endorse a wealth-stock tax; the 2026 podcast notes describe opposition to a Latvian wealth tax.

name: Andris Saulītis
detail: 2023 interview recommends a tax on large inheritances and gifts, not a tax on the stock of wealth.

name: Arvils Ašeradens (2024 tax proposal)
detail: The tax he presented is a 3% surcharge on annual income above €200,000, despite being labelled a wealth tax in the headline.
